title: About X-Ample Development
subtitle: We build premium FiveM assets with clean UX, performance-first code, and support you can rely on.
body:
X-Ample Development (also known as X-Ample Studios) creates modern FiveM scripts, MLOs, and gameplay experiences. We focus on readable UI, practical features, and maintainable code that’s easy to run on real servers.

Whether you’re upgrading an existing community or launching something new, we ship polished assets and can take on custom work when you need something bespoke.

highlights.title: Quality first
highlights.body: Consistent UI, sensible defaults, and attention to detail.

highlights.title: Performance-minded
highlights.body: Built to run smoothly and scale with your player base.

highlights.title: Support & iteration
highlights.body: We listen, fix issues quickly, and keep improving.

highlights.title: Security first
highlights.body: Security is our top priority, we ensure that all our scripts are secure and up to date.

highlights.title: Privacy focused
highlights.body: We ensure that all our scripts are privacy focused and do not collect any personal data.
